ContactId = ContactId column of 'Get Automated Joinings' (gen_automatedjoining JOIN Contact ON gen_applicantidentitynumber = Contact.gen_identitynumber, DTSX:854-856; unqualified, Contact presumed). Rows with NULL ContactId are skipped (main.cs:121-122).
crmWrites.condition: One Update per DISTINCT source row (SELECT DISTINCT over all 8 columns, DTSX:843-859): WHERE gen_joiningstatus in(7,8) and (e-mail branch A) or (marketing branch B) - SQL operator precedence makes this (status in (7,8) AND A) OR B, so branch-B rows are selected for ANY joining status. Script skips NULL ContactId (main.cs:121-122). Exceptions -> Row.DirectRowToErrors() (main.cs:151-155); the Errors output has no path (only paths DTSX:1963-1964), so failed updates are silently discarded.

attributes.expression: if (!Row.NotAuthorizedToUseDataSource_IsNull) contact["gen_notauthorizeforuse"] = new OptionSetValue(Row.NotAuthorizedToUseDataSource); else contact["gen_notauthorizeforuse"] = null; NotAuthorizedToUseDataSource = Derived Column 'Set field by other': ISNULL(gen_notauthorizeforuse) && !ISNULL(gen_datechangeingfromauthorizedtonotautorized) && gen_notauthorizetousedatasource == 1 ? NULL(DT_I4) : gen_notauthorizetousedatasource, where gen_notauthorizeforuse and gen_datechangeingfromauthorizedtonotautorized are the CONTACT's current values (Contact.*) and gen_notauthorizetousedatasource is the JOINING's value. Net effect: written = joining.gen_notauthorizetousedatasource as option value (same integer), except NULL (attribute cleared) when the contact's gen_notauthorizeforuse is empty AND its gen_datechangeingfromauthorizedtonotautorized is set AND the joining value is 1; a NULL joining value also clears the attribute. Written on EVERY processed row (no condition), even rows selected only because of the e-mail/marketing agreement.

notes: Writers in lineage (1): Update Contact - business CRM writer mapped here with 3 attributes (gen_notauthorizeforuse, donotsendmm, gen_quarterstatement). contact["contactid"] (main.cs:128) is the record key, not counted as a value attribute. No ETL plumbing writers exist in this package; Get Organization Variables\Set Variables only sets variables (no CRM write).

Source WHERE precedence (DTSX:857-859): "where gen_joiningstatus in(7,8) and (A) or (B)" is evaluated by SQL as (gen_joiningstatus in (7,8) AND A) OR B - rows matching marketing branch B are selected for joinings in any status. Whether this is intended cannot be determined from the DTSX.

Columns UpdateEmailAgreement and UpdateMarketingAgreement are computed in the SQL (DTSX:844-852) and passed to the script, but Row.UpdateEmailAgreement / Row.UpdateMarketingAgreement are never read in main.cs - dead inputs.

One contact can appear in several DISTINCT rows (several joinings with the same applicant identity number and different values). Each row performs its own Update; for gen_notauthorizeforuse the last processed row wins (no ORDER BY - order not determined).

gen_notauthorizeforuse is overwritten on every selected row (including clearing it to NULL when the joining value is NULL) although row selection is driven only by the e-mail/marketing agreement conditions.
